Name: Cherry Cove Farm
Author: ChincerDante
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
This mod lets you pick a new farm type: Cherry Cove Farm without replacing any of the base ones.
it offers tileable grass mostly for decor, the map is neatly divided and the farm house is in the middle, the teleports out of it are at the start of the paths not at the end for much faster travel, the design is similar to my other map "corners of the world" but this is a standard size map, less overwhelming.

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
[list]
[*]This mod requires Content patcher to function,.[/*]
[*]make sure your Smapi and Content patcher are up to date [/*]
[*]Install the folder provided under "Mods" in your stardew valley folder.[/*]
[/list][b]Main features[/b]
Tilable grass in most of the map, beside near walls and south pond for more random spawn chances.
A functioning quarry up on the mountains.
Blue grass in different patches around, so you can choose where to place your animals
forageable  sometimes spawn around the map.
berry bushes around the map.
beach forageables.
A dresser at the start (you can put clothes, rings and shoes in it)
(no it doesn't have unique fish rules compare to standard farms)

[b]Requirements[/b]
This mod requires Content patcher

Manifest.Name: CherryCove - Farm Map
Manifest.Description: A modified medium size map with forageables, a quarry and a lovely four areas aesthetic
